item.title: Drop-Leaf, Round or Banquette? Choose a Dining Table by Seated Footprint
item.description: A small apartment does not necessarily need a tiny dining table. It needs a dining setup whose real footprint fits the way you eat, sit, move and put the room back to work. A tabletop can look compact in a product photo and still turn awkward once the chairs are pulled out and a kitchen drawer or the entry door has to open. This guide compares five layouts, works through one calculated example and ends with a printable decision sheet and a ten-minute tape test.
